تنتهكي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِكِي (tantahikī) /tan.ta.hi.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# تُنْتَهَكِي (tuntahakī) /tun.ta.ha.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
